theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcdr_grid_segment
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (K : ℝ), 0 ≤ K → (∀ (z : Fin P → ℤ) (x y : Euclid P), x ∈ S → y ∈ S → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + 1) → dist (f x) (f y) ≤ K * dist x y) → ∀ x y : Euclid P, segment ℝ x y ⊆ S → dist (f x) (f y) ≤ K * dist x y
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
